mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative 5-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with negative 60-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 4% and increasing CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 100,000 over the past month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increase > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increase > 100k does not correlate with positive 5-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 10% does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and real GDP (GDPC1) is increasing, it signals accommodative monetary policy with economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS < 1% and increasing GDPC1 does not correlate with positive 60-day returns (correlation p > 0.05).
